description.value: The study examined age differences in neural recruitment during selective attention and cognitive reappraisal of emotional film clips using fMRI.

spans.text: The present study examined age differences in the timing and neural recruitment within lateral and medial PFC while younger and older adults hedonically regulated their responses to unpleasant film clips.
